title: Import wizard: use registered server-side import mappings (framework #2611)
body:
## What

The console side of framework's named import mappings (framework #2611, merged). When an object has registered `mapping` metadata artifacts targeting it, the data-import wizard can now drive an import from one instead of hand-building the column map every time.

- **`@object-ui/types`** — `ImportRequestOptions` gains `mappingName` (mirrors the server's `ImportRequest`; mutually exclusive with the inline `mapping` rename).
- **`@object-ui/data-objectstack`** — new `listImportMappings(objectName)`: lists `mapping` artifacts via the meta overlay API, filtered by `targetObject`. Feature-detected — degrades to an empty list (no selector) on older servers.
- **`@object-ui/plugin-grid` (ImportWizard)** — a **"Saved mapping" selector** appears in the mapping step when mappings exist. Picking one is **server-authoritative**:
  - the manual column table is replaced by a **read-only** `source → target (transform)` summary of the artifact;
  - the write-mode panel is hidden (the artifact's `mode`/`upsertKey` own write semantics);
  - submit sends `mappingName` over **source-header rows** (`buildSourceRows`), so the server applies rename + transforms + coercion — the client never re-implements transforms (that would be a second, drifting dialect of the server's mapping logic);
  - a preview banner states the server will transform on import; clearing returns to the manual flow.
- New `grid.import.*` strings added across all 11 locales.

## Why

The framework can register reusable, governed import mappings, but until now the only way to use one was a raw API call. Enterprise imports (recurring vendor feeds, packaged migration kits) need to be runnable from the UI by a non-developer — this closes that last mile: pick a saved mapping, preview, import.

## Verification

- `plugin-grid` test suite: **190 passing** (25 files), incl. 9 new — pure transform/row-shaping helpers (`savedMapping.test.ts`) and the `assembleImportRequest` named-mapping branch (`importSavedMapping.test.ts`).
- Type-checked + linted; new files are clean. (Note: the base branch has pre-existing, unrelated type-check/lint findings in `exportDownload.test.ts` and BOM-in-CSV export helpers — present before this change, not touched here.)

## Notes

The manual column-mapping flow and the existing localStorage mapping *templates* are unchanged — the named-mapping selector is additive and only shows when the server offers mappings for the object.
